description: A dependency manager for .NET with support for NuGet packages and git repositories.
releaseNotes:
BREAKING: `paket pack --release-notes-file` reads the file with Fake.Core.ReleaseNotes 6, in the formats described in https://fake.build/reference/fake-core-releasenotes.html: the package version is the first word of the latest header that is a whole SemVer version, so `## [1.2.3] - 2020-01-01` and `## v1.2.3 - 2020-01-01` give `2020-01-01`; pass `--version` for such headers. Prerelease versions like `1.2.3-beta.11.2` are no longer cut, and build metadata (`+sha.abc`) is kept - https://github.com/fsprojects/FAKE/pull/2686
Looking for projects no longer runs forever on a cyclic directory link, as in a Nix `.devenv` profile. `paket pack` still follows the links when it looks for template files - https://github.com/fsprojects/Paket/pull/4421 @michaelglass
BREAKING: Paket no longer looks for projects and `paket.template` files in the folders whose name starts with a dot, like `.devenv`, nor in the folders that are links, as `paket convert-from-nuget` already did for the solutions and NuGet files: the projects there are left out of install, restore, update, remove and pack. Until now only `.git` and `.fable` were skipped. A cyclic link, as in a Nix `.devenv` profile, no longer makes the search run forever - https://github.com/fsprojects/Paket/pull/4421
BREAKING: The obsolete `InstallModel.CreateFromLibs` and `InstallModel.createFromLibs`, `InstallModel.GetLibReferences` and `PlatformMatching.getFrameworkPathPenalty` of Paket.Core are removed: use `InstallModel.CreateFromContent` and `createFromContent`, `GetLegacyReferences` or `GetCompileReferences`, and `PlatformMatching.getPathPenalty`. So is the `Fake.Globbing` module that Paket.Core carried from FAKE 4: use `Fake.IO.Globbing.Glob` of the Fake.IO.FileSystem package. So are `NuGetCache.NuGetConfig.writeNuGetConfig` and `Constants.NuGetConfigFile`, unused since the end of the project.json support
The warning about the FSharp.Core binding redirects of F# projects links to an existing section of the documentation
Update Argu from 6.1.1 to 6.2.5, and System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager from 4.7 to 10.0, so the `paket` tool no longer ships System.Drawing.Common 4.7 and its critical vulnerability (GHSA-rxg9-xrhp-64gj). The help of `paket update`, `paket find-packages` and `paket generate-nuspec` no longer shows their optional package ID, search text and `output` directory as required
